run.decision: FAIL / NO_ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS. The preregistered one-shot C3/L3 core switch increased full-history CAGR to 14.504572% from frozen V11 14.345615% while keeping MDD at 7.771319% and satisfying the unlevered max-gross/nonnegative-weight and fee-invariant-target constraints. However full Sharpe fell to 1.516321 versus V11 1.522263 and only 3/7 fixed folds matched or exceeded V11 Sharpe. The frozen paired 20,000-replicate bootstrap also failed: P(CAGR candidate>V11)=81.320% and P(Sharpe candidate>V11)=35.565%, with a negative median Sharpe delta, although MDD P97.5=14.5752458% and cumulative 44-candidate DSR=96.981% passed their individual gates. Therefore deterministic and bootstrap admission fail and robust_strategy_pass=false. Per the preregistered stop rule, no OR/AND, lookback, threshold, source-event, blend, band, fee, or rescue variant may be opened under this campaign.

methodology.follow_up_policy: One-shot result-informed architecture test. After performance is opened, do not change C3/L3 OR to AND, 8/4 release lookbacks, -0.03 thresholds, source-event union, stress/calm mapping, HighCore/V11 source definitions, blend fractions, band, fee semantics, or add any second rescue variant. Failure closes this retrospective core-switch campaign.

deterministic: full Sharpe >= frozen V11 Sharpe
deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe
deterministic: target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or shorting
deterministic: candidate target fingerprint identical under 1.00% and 0.03% user fees
deterministic: frozen stress-event count identical under 1.00% and 0.03% user fees and source_events=stress_events+calm_events
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks candidate versus V11, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822

global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using 43 prior performance-bearing formal candidates plus this candidate, total 44
ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and DSR gate
methodology.selection_metric: No model selection. One mechanically defined candidate uses the already-frozen C3/L3 state to choose between two already-frozen source targets.

version.mechanism_text: The standalone HighCore has strong CAGR evidence but inconsistent fold Sharpe. Using the exact frozen V11 DualCore target only on existing C3/L3 stress events and the exact HighCore target otherwise can retain HighCore return uplift while restoring cross-regime risk-adjusted consistency, without adding numeric thresholds, leverage, financing, new assets, or new daily timing events.

allowed_changes: candidate source targets are exactly the frozen V11 DualCore targets and exact current V11 HighCore targets; neither source strategy is modified
source event dates are the fixed union of actual V11 and HighCore trade dates; no extra daily timing events are added
on each source event signal date, stress=true iff frozen V11 C3/L3 state triggers: 8-release NFCICREDIT change <= -0.03 OR 4-release NFCILEVERAGE change <= -0.03
if stress=true use the exact V11 target; otherwise use the exact HighCore target
replay through the shared BacktestDailySimulator with the frozen 25% band, max gross 100%, no shorting, no financing
user fee may affect execution P&L only; candidate target fingerprint and C3/L3 stress-event count must be identical under 1.00% and 0.03% fee

candidate_definition.source_event_scope: union of V11 and HighCore actual trade dates

forbidden_changes: C3/L3 OR-to-AND or any alternate logical combination
any C3/L3 lookback or threshold change
any alternative stress selector, volatility gate, drawdown gate, factor, timing, or market regime
any blend between V11 and HighCore; candidate must select exactly one frozen target at each source event
any new event date outside the frozen source-event union
any modification to V11 or HighCore source implementations
leverage, financing, shorting, negative target weights, gross above 100%, or fee-driven target changes
rerunning a modified rescue candidate after seeing the result
